title: NADRA Simplifies Replacement of Lost or Damaged CNICs
excerpt: The National Database and Registration Authority has released a step-by-step guide to help citizens replace lost or damaged identity cards.
body_html:
The National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) has issued a detailed guide for citizens seeking to replace their lost or damaged Computerized National Identity Cards (CNICs).

Step-by-Step Replacement Process

The newly shared instructions aim to streamline the procedure for obtaining a new identity card when the original document is missing or compromised.

  • Citizens can follow the provided official steps to request a replacement.
  • The guidelines cover the necessary actions required to complete the CNIC reissuance process.

The authority released this information to assist the public in navigating the replacement system more efficiently.
